title: Settlement Agreements Correspondence Schedule: Letter Timing, Email Delivery and Notices by Programme
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Correspondence Schedule

Every settlement under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements is in writing, and each programme sets the figures that govern its letters: the business days within which the offer letter, the acceptance confirmation and the default notice are sent, whether the offer letter may go by email, whether the acceptance confirmation must be sent before the first settlement payment is taken, whether letters on accounts past their statute-of-limitations date carry the time-barred disclosure, and the waived amount at or above which the acceptance confirmation carries the cancelled-debt tax notice.

| Figure | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offer letter sent within (business days after the offer date) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Acceptance confirmation sent within (business days after acceptance) | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Default notice sent within (business days after a default) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Offer letter may be delivered by email | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Acceptance confirmation sent before the first settlement payment is taken | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Time-barred disclosure required on letters for accounts past the statute-of-limitations date | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Waived amount at or above which the acceptance confirmation carries the cancelled-debt tax notice (USD) | 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The Six-Payment Settlement and the Hardship Settlement have the longer offer-letter time, 2 business days, and their offer letters do not go by email.
- The Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement has the shortest acceptance-confirmation time, 1 business day.
- The tax-notice figure is the same 600.00 dollars at every programme; the threshold is met at exactly 600.00 dollars.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Lump-Sum Settlement that waives 600.00 dollars meets the tax-notice figure; one that waives 599.99 dollars does not.
